assembly.source_rendering_notes: Faithful native arXivv3 material adapted under CC BY-SA4.0; this material retains the same ShareAlike license. All mathematical sections, explicit axiom tables and the full native proof appendix are retained. Every native input file is mechanically flattened; 351 named TikZ diagrams are embedded literally as editable native code, without redraw or rendering. The small diagram file loader is mechanically replaced by an inline lookup using the same call names and TikZiT baseline/layers; author mathematical macros and diagrams are unchanged. Unused mathdots import is omitted after no native special-dot command use was found. Native biblatex/biber semantics retained. Coisotropic/application material is context only, not extra counted results. No proof assistant or own compiler run. Five electrical application symbol inputs (resistor/voltage/current/inductor/capacitor) are now literally inlined from their original author .tex files; all source-span offsets are mechanically updated. Original pre-inline body and native archive retained. No global guard or author mathematics changed. Actual first engine trace exposed an artificial terminal paragraph token added by inline macro wrapping after native end{tikzpicture}. All351 diagram wrappers are regenerated from unchanged original diagrams with exactly one terminal newline before the macro close, eliminating wrapper-only blank paragraphs. Original previous preamble retained; diagram tokens and mathematical contents are unchanged. Final engine log confirmed exactly these nine unresolved native hyperlinks, not first-pass cross-reference noise. Only those nine nonresolving hyperlink wrappers are removed while their visible author text is retained. Original author unresolved hyperlinks: the scalable axiom chart labels T.Id.1, T.Id.2, T.Id.3, T.One.1, T.One.2 and T.Z target a literal question-mark placeholder; T.Copy, T.Times and T.Zero target lem:tcopy, lem:ttimes and lem:tzero, which are absent from the complete native source. These nine author labels are displayed unchanged as plain text with no guessed link destination. Their graphical equations remain unchanged; original source and unresolved-link preamble are retained.
